source_identity_definition: near-duplicate cluster_id, falling back to source_id
ci_rule: Resample 1024 actual unique source-array clusters with replacement, 1024 clusters per draw, retaining all their rows; 2000 draws with NumPy PCG64 default_rng seed20261026; percentile linear quantiles .025/.975.
position_semantics: position_bin is the quartile of absolute token position in each whole actual input, not per-message relative body position or the last quarter of each message body.

formulas.prediction: six-class argmax of committed float32 probabilities
formulas.macro_f1: arithmetic mean F1 over classes with true support; overall TEST has all six classes

limitations: This verifies committed labels/probabilities/group metadata; it does not rerun the frozen model or verify x feature vectors.
Subgroup macro-F1 averages only roles with true support; stages with only cot or tool targets are not six-class tests.
Position groups here use whole-input absolute quartiles; per-body tail diagnostics require the separate position report.
TEST diagnostics do not alter the already frozen DEV-only selection.
